Alibaba Model Studio's Qwen4-Max. Priced at the Beijing / global deployment tier: the international pricing page (read raw 2026-11-23T14:05Z, re-read 2026-11-28) publishes that tier in USD, $1.413 input / $4.24 output per million tokens, thinking and answer alike, in one bracket 0<Token≤1M, so no long-context surcharge; the domestic page (read raw 2026-11-23T13:53Z, re-read 2026-11-28) lists the same tier at ¥10 / ¥30 with the labels Batch at half and context cache at a discount — labels, not numeric tables. The stored cache rates are read-time values: the international page's qwen4-max cache sub-tables at the 2026-11-23T14:05Z read printed $1.767 for the 5m explicit write (the catalog's cache_write_basis) and $0.071 for an explicit or implicit hit; the page removed those sub-tables by 2026-11-23T17:50Z, they are absent on the 2026-11-28 re-read, and the closest Wayback snapshot (2026-11-12) predates the row, so no live public page prints them in USD today. Kept provisionally at the read-time values, agreed in review on !31441608; re-read and move them when a public source prints them again. Both stored rates are corroborated live by the Model Studio console's qwen4-max model page (Beijing region, model-market detail, readable without login; read 2026-11-28T12:06Z), which prints the cache table in CNY at original prices, no promo label on any cache line (the page's only limited-time discount is Batch Chat at half): 12.5 yuan per million tokens for the 5m explicit creation, 20 yuan for the 1h explicit creation, 0.5 yuan for the explicit hit and 0.5 yuan on the input cache-hit line, the implicit hit; at the same 10-yuan-to-$1.413 input ratio the two pricing pages publish, 12.5 x 0.1413 = 1.76625 rounds to the stored 1.767 and 0.5 x 0.1413 = 0.07065 rounds to the stored 0.071. The explicit-cache (Qwen4) page (read 2026-11-28 on both sites) matches those creation ratios: about 125% of input for TTL 5m and about 200% for TTL 1h (default 5m), as 12.5 and 20 are of 10; the context-cache page (re-read 2026-11-28) exempts qwen4-max from the general ratios in both explicit and implicit mode and points at the console, which is where the numeric hit price lives. The catalog has no per-region rows, so every qwen4-max request prices at this tier even if served from the international (Singapore) or US deployment, which the page lists separately at $1.5 / $4.5. No Fast, Flex or Ultrafast tier is published for it, so those rules are null and price at Standard as an estimate; Batch is half, per the domestic label.
